benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The |J|-max, Fiedler, union, quarter-pi, classical-popcount, repulsion-escape, QAOA-depth, energy-legal selection, uniform-box, and scale-normalized radius rounds are not rerun and their verdicts are not edited.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..165 were used in earlier rounds, except that k=100 and k=101 are the round-1 held-out instances and are not used. 178 and above stay unused.
forbidden: an energy-only union of two packings
a pi/4 or pi/2 shell displacement
a uniform draw from the full parameter box
a scale-normalized sphere around the finished L=6 vector
using fidelity or a quantum eigenvector to score, start, or select

families.nodata: standard shared-gamma search, interleaved, present only so K can nest. Not the claim.
families.K: standard shared-gamma search, interleaved, present only so KM can nest. Not the claim.
families.KM: original shared-gamma KM, interleaved triples, 3+3L, round-4 starts. This is the continuation column.
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-4 starts, repeats 0 and 1. This is the comparator.
families.KM_div: the same KM circuit. Extra lineages start from optimized L=1 states the energy beam dropped. Not a new ansatz.

packing: interleaved triples [[a, a+N/3, a+2N/3] for a in 0..N/3). The same partition at every layer and at every N. FK = J@J with zero diagonal, rms-normalized. FM = block means on these triples.
diverse_screen: After the standard L=1 KM optimizations of one repeat, let B be distinct_parents with the frozen beam. A discarded state is eligible when its Euclidean distance to the nearest state in B, in units of each coordinate's box half-width, is at least min_sep. Keep the eligible states with the largest distance, at most diverse_count. Ties break by lower energy, then by label. Each kept state is one lineage. The screen does not use fidelity.
lineage: From L=2 through L=6, each lineage is continued by Zhou interpolation, time-rescaled shared coefficients, and raw perturbations 0.1 and 0.3. The parent of the next depth is the lowest-energy child of that lineage. Lineages are not inserted into the standard beam and do not change the continuation column. Perturbation seed [20261306, N, k, L, r, lineage, j]. The continuation L=6 vector is kept, so the diverse-inclusive energy is at most the continuation energy.
architecture: cavity X frame, one gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM, three shell angles per layer, same UcX at every layer. QAOA is the usual independent-angle circuit.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]
optimizer: L-BFGS-B, analytic adjoint gradient, true energy, no classical penalty

seeds.note: Standard starts use the round-4 integer prefixes. family_index is the position in family_order, so KM is 2 and qaoa is 3. The lineage seed is new. k=100 and k=101 are not used.

continuation: Zhou interpolation, time-rescaled shared coefficients, perturbations 0.1 and 0.3, two ramps, and for QAOA the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05). The diverse lineages use those same four KM maps and are not radius-1 kicks and not full-box draws.
selection: lowest true energy. The continuation column uses the lower of repeats 0 and 1. KM_div uses the lowest energy among that continuation L=6 vector and the L=6 states of the diverse lineages. No ground state, eigenvector of H, E0, or fidelity in the starts or the selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.equal_search_note: The continuation column is equal search. The diverse column adds up to three lineages per repeat and is not equal search.
confirmation.pass_at_N: wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.overall_confirmed: all three N pass on the diverse-inclusive column
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 passes on the diverse-inclusive column and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_not_confirmed: N=6 does not pass on the diverse-inclusive column
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 8 instances with both continuation repeats complete and the diverse lineages finished

diagnosis.role: frozen reading of whether the diverse lineages lowered the KM energy. It does not rewrite the win rule after the fit.
diagnosis.energy_drop: continuation KM L=6 energy minus diverse-inclusive L=6 energy
diagnosis.deeper: median energy drop > 0.01, or at least 4 instances have energy drop > 0.01
diagnosis.reading_deeper_and_pass_changes: The diverse lineages lower the KM energy and the pass bit changes.
diagnosis.reading_deeper_and_pass_same: The diverse lineages lower the KM energy, and the pass bit is the same as the continuation column.
diagnosis.reading_not_deeper_and_base_fails: The diverse L=1 lineages did not lower the KM energy under the frozen 0.01 rule. The continuation minimum was not beaten on this sample.
diagnosis.reading_base_passes: Continuation KM clears the historical comparator on this sample. The diverse column says whether a lower energy keeps that clearance.

secondary_equal_param.role: reported only, not part of the verdict. Continuation KM only; the diverse lineages are not included.

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6. Within a job, repeats r=0 then r=1, and within a repeat nodata, K, KM, qaoa, depth 1 then 6. The diverse lineages run after both repeats.
